description: Create a Brevo SMS campaign as draft (POST /smsCampaigns). Required: name, sender, content. Optional: recipients ({ listIds, exclusionListIds }), scheduledAt (schedules the send!), unicodeEnabled, organisationPrefix, unsubscribeInstruction.

name.description: Name of the Brevo SMS campaign

organisationPrefix.description: Organisation name prefixed to the SMS text

scheduledAt.description: ISO timestamp; setting it schedules the actual send

sender.description: Sender name of the SMS campaign

unicodeEnabled.description: Allow unicode characters in the SMS text

unsubscribeInstruction.description: Opt-out instruction appended to the SMS

name: create_brevo_sms_campaign
